questions.question: Is there a named, logged policy-governance process covering risk decisions the system makes?
Is there a written, factual statement of what the automated decision path does and does not do?
Is access to write operations gated by a permission distinct from read access, with an explicit default-deny for roles not granted it?
questions.evidence_ref: actaseal/api/rbac.py PERM_MANAGE_POLICIES (fail-closed default: only Admin role holds it)

questions.question: Are unknown/unmatched input shapes (action type, evidence packet, amount band) failed closed rather than defaulted to allow?
questions.evidence_ref: CLAUDE.md Style section: 'Fail closed. Unknown action type, unmatched amount band, invalid evidence packet -- all block.'

questions.question: Does the vendor operate the buyer's cloud infrastructure, or does the product deploy into infrastructure the buyer controls?
questions.evidence_ref: ActaSeal deploys into the buyer's own infrastructure/cloud account; there is no ActaSeal-operated multi-tenant cloud to assess

questions.question: Does record verification depend on a vendor-held private key at verification time?
questions.evidence_ref: actaseal/signing.py: verification only ever needs the PUBLIC key (ReceiptKeyRing); the private key lives behind an external ReceiptSigner boundary the vendor does not hold

questions.question: Is there a defined post-quantum cryptography migration path?
questions.evidence_ref: actaseal/crypto/pq_signer.py (ML-DSA-65/87 signing branches, gated on optional liboqs-python); docs/trust/cnsa2_pq_profile.md

questions.question: Is there a defined mechanism to satisfy erasure requests without deleting audit-log rows?
Describe background-check and security-awareness training programs for vendor personnel.
questions.evidence_ref: Organizational HR policy question outside this codebase's controls; a human must answer this from the vendor's actual HR practice, not invent one here

questions.question: Are security-relevant anomalies (e.g. scope breaches) recorded as durable, queryable incidents?
Is log-append failure fail-closed (blocks the action) rather than silently dropped?
Describe physical security controls at the facility hosting this service.
questions.evidence_ref: No ActaSeal-operated physical facility exists; the product deploys into the buyer's own infrastructure

questions.question: Is there a tested disaster-recovery plan with a defined RTO/RPO?
questions.evidence_ref: actaseal/ops/backup.py provides backup/restore primitives; a formal tested BCP/DR plan with committed RTO/RPO does not yet exist -- honest gap

questions.question: Are release artifacts accompanied by a software bill of materials and provenance attestation?
Is there a documented mapping from this product's evidence/logging features to specific privacy/AI-governance regulatory requirements?
